market.title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Orlando, Florida | PetTripFinder
market.meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across Greater Orlando -- Downtown, MCO airport, International Drive and the Convention Center, Universal, SeaWorld, Lake Buena Vista and Walt Disney World, Kissimmee and Celebration, Winter Park and Lake Mary -- with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel's own official website.
market.introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel's own official website.
market._boundary_note: Membership is the property's OWN postal code, as its own official page or its Florida DBPR public-lodging licence states it, joined to the corridor registry. A multi-core theme-park, convention and airport travel market -- not Orlando's city limits and not all of Central Florida. Nothing else admits a property: not a brand's 'Orlando', 'Disney Area' or 'Maingate' marketing name, not a map pin, not a vacation-rental listing, not a competitor directory's city label.
market._corridor_note: Corridors are a postal-code partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY). Universal, the Convention Center and International Drive share 32819; SeaWorld and I-Drive South share 32821; Disney Springs shares 32830 with Walt Disney World; Celebration shares 34747 with West US-192. Each shared code is one corridor and its named submarkets are reported as overlays.
market._census_membership_note: Individual condominium units (DBPR CNDO), vacation dwellings (DWEL), vacation homes, whole-home rental communities, property-management portfolios, Airbnb / Vrbo inventory, ordinary apartments, individual timeshare units, private resort residences and military-only lodging are never admitted. A mixed hotel / timeshare / condo campus is admitted only as the exact hotel premises its operator sells as a hotel.
